---
title: 'Status Report #6'
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-10-29"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r prepare}
# Load cleaned data from Status Report #1 and view it (make sure it looks right)
HeartAttackClean <- readRDS("HeartAttackClean.rds")

# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r visualizations}
# Convert Outcome to a labeled factor
HeartAttackClean <- HeartAttackClean %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, 
                          levels = c(0, 1),
                          labels = c("No Heart Attack", "Heart Attack")))

# Age vs Outcome (boxplot)
ggplot(HeartAttackClean, aes(x = Outcome, y = Age, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Age vs Heart Attack Outcome",
       x = "Outcome", y = "Age") +
  theme_minimal()

# Gender vs Outcome (bar chart)
ggplot(HeartAttackClean, aes(x = Gender, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Gender Distribution by Outcome",
       x = "Gender", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_minimal()

# Cholesterol vs Outcome (boxplot)
ggplot(HeartAttackClean, aes(x = Outcome, y = Cholesterol, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Cholesterol vs Heart Attack Outcome",
       x = "Outcome", y = "Cholesterol") +
  theme_minimal()

# Blood Pressure vs Outcome (boxplot)
ggplot(HeartAttackClean, aes(x = Outcome, y = BloodPressure, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Blood Pressure vs Heart Attack Outcome",
       x = "Outcome", y = "Blood Pressure") +
  theme_minimal()

# Smoking vs Outcome (bar chart)
ggplot(HeartAttackClean, aes(x = Smoker, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Smoking Status by Outcome",
       x = "Smoker", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_minimal()

# Physical Activity vs Outcome (bar chart)
ggplot(HeartAttackClean, aes(x = PhysicalActivity, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "Physical Activity by Outcome",
       x = "Physical Activity", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_minimal()
```
